QuestInfo.name: Meaning of Regret
QuestInfo.0: Sorcerer wants to speak with you. Go see the Sorcerer.
QuestInfo.1: The Sorcerer wants you to prove that you have no regrets by passing a simple test. Go face  your feelings of regret in #b#MDmirrorD_328_1_##k.
QuestInfo.2: You faced your regrets from your dark past in #b#MDmirrorD_328_1_##k.

0.0: Perhaps regret is the strongest of memories. Humans tend to regret past choices. What about you?\r\n#L0##bI regret nothing. #l\n#k
0.1: No regrets, you say? Impressive... There are two types of people who say that...those who acknowledge their past, and those who ignore it. I wonder which one you are? I want to put you to a simple test.

yes.0: You will know which one of the two camps you belong to when you face your regrets. Find #r#t4009114##k and #r#t4009115##k in #b#MDmirrorD_328_1_##k to reveal the truth.

no.0: Having regrets isn't embarrassing. It's far more embarrassing to make mistakes that you do not learn from.

1.0: How does it feel to face your regrets? You must have a strong mind if you made it back unscathed.
